lines.text: Look at Indonesia! Okay... zoom in closer. Wait... not Java! Over here... right there!
This is Bali. Home to beautiful beaches... and tigers! Now look right next door. Literally twenty miles away.
Lombok. You'd expect tigers here too, right? Nope. Not a single one! Never was.
Wait... tigers are amazing swimmers! Why wouldn't they just cross? Are they scared of the water?
Well... look at the birds. Even birds that could fly across in twenty minutes... turn right around at the border!
Instead, Lombok has these guys: tree kangaroos and yellow-crested cockatoos. Pure Australian wildlife!
What is going on here?! Grab your snorkel. Down here... between these two islands...
The sea floor doesn't just drop. It plunges into a massive, pitch-black underwater trench!
During the Ice Age, animals walked all the way to Bali on dry land. But this trench? It never dried up! Not for fifty million years.
These two islands aren't neighbors. They're two different worlds that crashed into each other!
